text.en:
Subsection (a) of section two of Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty-four is hereby
amended so as to read as follows:
"Section 2. (a) If the building is not of strong building materials, constructed in accordance with a plan,
specifications, and estimate of cost approved by the Secretary of Labor and the Director of Public Works."
Section six of Act Numbered Forty-one hundred and eighty-four is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 13, 1936.
